papers.title_en: PureTD: Reinforcement Learning for Backgammon Money Games with No Evaluation-time Search
papers.evidence: 十五子棋现金局的自对弈强化学习，无搜索
papers.tldr: 西洋双陆棋程序传统依赖评估时搜索提升棋力，但搜索开销大且可能限制自我对弈学习。PureTD从零开始通过自对弈强化学习同时训练走棋与加倍立方体动作，完全弃用专家特征与搜索。在cubeful金钱局中，该无搜索模型接近最先进水平，评估更快且显著强于GNU Backgammon和Open Sage的1-ply前瞻搜索。这表明纯自我对弈RL足以训练强大无搜索双陆棋代理，为无搜索方法提供新基准。
papers.abstract_en: We revisit Tesauro's TD-Gammon for backgammon money games in the setting of no evaluation-time search. Both checker play and cube action (use of the doubling cube) are learned from scratch via self-play reinforcement learning (RL), with minimal hand-coded logic and no expert features. In this setting, we demonstrate that pure self-play RL suffices to train models that reach near-state-of-the-art playing strength. Specifically, for cubeful money games, our search-free model evaluates faster and is substantially stronger than the open-source engines GNU Backgammon and Open Sage running a one-move (1-ply) look-ahead search.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Mixing of Policies from Searching and Policies from Learning
papers.evidence: 将神经网络策略与蒙特卡洛树搜索混合，并与AlphaZero和DQN对比用于符号问题
papers.tldr: 强化学习中通过搜索生成训练目标并蒸馏已被证明有效，但固定深度搜索常导致高昂计算成本。Flexer根据策略网络先验质量动态调整搜索深度，每步混合神经网络策略与蒙特卡洛树搜索策略，混合因子随网络模仿误差和环境模型方差增大而偏向搜索策略。在三个玩具符号问题上，Flexer部分实验超越AlphaZero变体、DQN和ADP。该工作表明自适应混合搜索与学习策略有助于在保持性能的同时降低搜索开销。
papers.abstract_en: Background: Distillation of training targets generated thru search/planning has proven useful in reinforcement learning, but search can take exceedingly long. Objectives: Rather than perform search to the same depth every time (typically at a fixed period of steps), reduce the search depth proportionally to the quality of the policy network priors. Methods: We describe Flexer, an architecture that, for each step, mixes the policy from a neural network and the policy from Monte Carlo tree search. The mixing factor favors the MCTS policy as the policy imitation error of the network and the environment models' variance increases. Results: Flexer outperforms a version of AlphaZero (and DQN and ADP) for some experiments on three toy symbolic problems.

papers.title_en: Chronocooked: A Benchmark for Implicit Interval Timing in Reinforcement Learning Agents
papers.authors: Amrapali Pednekar, Alvaro Garrido-Perez, Yara Khaluf, Pieter Simoens
papers.evidence: 基于Overcooked启发的烹饪场景的强化学习基准测试，用于隐式间隔计时
papers.tldr: 强化学习智能体在需要时间决策的任务中常缺乏内隐计时能力，现有基准未充分考察时间信息不可观测但至关重要的场景。本文提出Chronocooked基准，受Overcooked启发设计烹饪场景，使时间信息完全不可观测，并且奖励函数隐含时间依赖。使用非循环、循环和生物可行模型进行基线评测，评估指标专门暴露智能体计时能力的局限性。该基准旨在推动人工代理融入时间感知与时间处理能力，以适配人机交互和时间依赖的人类社会。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark suite for studying implicit interval timing in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios that require temporal decision making. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved yet critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models. Evaluation metrics are designed to expose limitations in timing abilities of RL agents, and we report baselines using a non-recurrent, a recurrent, and a biologically plausible model. This work ultimately aims to underscore the need to incorporate time perception and temporal processing in artificial agents designed for human robot interaction and deployment in time dependent human societies.

papers.title_en: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin
papers.authors: Alexy Skoutnev, Kirill Acharya, Gaston Longhitano, Madeleine Udell, Kevin Ellis, Iddo Drori
papers.evidence: 测试时世界模型推理用于玩未知游戏，与游戏AI bot开发相关
papers.tldr: 在ARC-AGI-3等规则与目标隐藏的持续学习游戏中，传统方法需为每个任务手工设计模型。Twin系统让编码智能体通过仿真与交互构建可执行世界模型，并用回放验证和反例修复强制模型匹配所有观察到的转移。该系统清除97.8%的183个关卡，动作效率超过人类88.3%，将同一基础模型得分从7.8%提升至93.3%。研究表明构建世界模型比预期简单，真正的难点在于推断正确目标。
papers.abstract_en: We present a Test-time World-model Inference (Twin) system, in which a frontier coding agent writes an executable world model for completing continual learning tasks, such as ARC-AGI-3 games. Traditional approaches hand-engineer such models, one custom design per task. Each game hides its rules and goal, and our system constructs them from simulation and interaction alone. Its inductive prior over grid games is strong enough to recover the true transitions of the game and the goal on nearly all levels. Replay validation happens in a twin world model. The harness enforces that an action is not made until the program reproduces every previous observed game transition. Each mismatch between a world model prediction and the actual action result becomes a counterexample that is used to repair the world model. Twin clears 179 out of 183 levels (97.8%), and does so more efficiently than humans in 158 out of 179 levels (88.3%). The system infers the goal before any reward on 156 of the levels it clears (87.2%), and in the remaining levels automatically discovers the goal by search. The benchmark scores completion and action efficiency, between 0 and 100, against humans playing each game for the first time. Played directly, the base model scores only 7.8%; an off-the-shelf harness increases it to 61.1%, whereas our twin world model increases the same base model to 93.3%, clearing 23 out of 25 games. Building a usable world model is simpler than anticipated, whereas the harder problem is inferring the right goal.

papers.authors: Ondrej Bajgar, Peter Tisnikar, Alessandro Abate, Konstantinos Gatsis, Maike Osborne
papers.evidence: 逆强化学习从专家行为中恢复奖励函数，可用于人类化游戏AI
papers.tldr: 在安全关键AI中，显式设定奖励函数常不可行，逆强化学习（IRL）从专家行为推断奖励是有效途径。本文提出 QVIRL，一种贝叶斯IRL方法，通过变分学习最优Q值分布来恢复奖励后验，兼顾可扩展性与不确定性量化。在网格世界、Lunar Lander、Highway及两个ATARI游戏等任务上展示学徒学习强性能，支持静态专家数据和主动学习。这是首个能从原始像素观测训练贝叶斯IRL的方法，为安全关键应用提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: The development of safe and beneficial AI requires that systems can learn and act in accordance with human preferences. However, explicitly specifying these preferences by hand is often infeasible. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) addresses this challenge by inferring preferences, represented as reward functions, from expert behaviour. We introduce Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL), a novel Bayesian IRL method that recovers a posterior distribution over rewards from expert demonstrations via primarily learning a variational distribution over optimal Q-values. Unlike previous approaches, QVIRL combines scalability with uncertainty quantification, important for safety-critical applications as well as active learning. We demonstrate QVIRL's strong performance in apprenticeship learning across various tasks, including gridworlds, Lunar Lander, the Highway Environment, and two ATARI games both with static expert data and with active learning. It is the first method for Bayesian IRL that demonstrates training from raw pixel observations.

papers.title_en: Watermarked Game Solving via Perturbed Regret Minimization
papers.evidence: 通过扰动后悔最小化为不完美信息博弈中的游戏代理添加水印
papers.tldr: 随着AI博弈智能体能力提升，其被恶意滥用的风险日益突出，催生对水印技术的需求。然而现有水印方法局限于完美信息博弈，无法覆盖不完美信息场景。本文提出扰动遗憾最小化方法，通过在学习过程中向效用添加扰动来嵌入水印，并直接集成于训练过程。实验表明水印仅带来微小且有界的可利用性代价，且可在人类速度下几小时的对局中被检测到。该方法为更广泛博弈类型中的智能体水印提供了可行且低开销的解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world interactions among self-interested parties can be modeled by game theory, and the rapid advancements in AI have raised concerns about the possible misuse---accidental or deliberate---of superhuman or human-level game-playing agents by bad actors. While AI watermarking has mainly been applied to LLM-generated texts, a recent line of work proposes developing watermarking techniques for agents in game-theoretic settings. However, existing watermarking techniques for game-theoretic agents are not readily applicable due to their limited scope or capabilities---they are tailored to perfect-information games and are thus inapplicable to richer game types. We propose a new approach to watermarking game-playing agents, which a) can be applied to imperfect-information settings; b) is directly integrated into the learning process itself; and c) incurs only a bounded cost in exploitability. For this purpose, we introduce perturbed regret minimization, which adds perturbations to the utilities prior to observation so as to encourage the learning algorithm to embed the watermark. Our experiments show that the watermark incurs only a small exploitability cost and can be detected within just a couple of hours of gameplay at human speed.
